name: untitled-capybara-game
description: A physics sandbox where a mischievous capybara terrorises nineteen places.
//: There are no dependencies and there is no bundler. The two libraries the
game is built on are checked in under vendor/ (see vendor/README.md for
versions, checksums and licences); build.mjs inlines them, along with the
twenty-eight source modules, into one self-contained HTML file.
`npm start` serves the unbundled source for development. `npm run build`
produces dist/untitled-capybara-game.html, which needs no server and no
network and opens straight from file://.
This package is marked private and carries no `license` field on purpose:
the repository has no LICENSE file yet, and picking one is the author's
call, not the build's. Until there is one, nobody else has permission to
use this — which is the one thing left in the way of sharing it.
